requirements: Dismissing the in-app rest timer removes its notification and prevents the pending alert.
Notification Cancel removes the notification, persisted timer, and in-app countdown.
Cancellation synchronizes while the app is foregrounded and after unlocking or reopening.

checks: Started a manual rest from an existing exercise, then tapped notification Cancel. Notification, timer bar, saved state, and service disappeared.
Started another rest and tapped Stop rest timer in the app. The active notification and service were removed.
Paused, resumed, paused again, and dismissed. The notification disappeared on pause, returned on resume, and stayed absent after cancellation.
Dispatched the native cancellation action as the app UID while its activity remained foregrounded. The timer bar disappeared without a lifecycle resume.
Cancelled from the expanded notification after locking the emulator. The timer stayed dismissed on return to the exercise.
Waited beyond the cancelled timer deadline. Saved state remained empty, with no active timer service or app notification.
Force-stopped and reopened the app. The timer did not return.
Installed release 1.9.3 ARM64 and checked Home with the restored original data.
